'''Yuancai''' is a researcher working at [[Huaxu Academy]]. She can be found next to [[Tian Menglin]].

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Yuancai:''' Hey, check it out! It's the first Resonance Nexus in Huanglong, part of our institute's collection. Isn't it gorgeous? 
:'''Yuancai:''' Back when I was a student, I visited the institute once. When my hand touched its surface, the metal felt chilly, almost as if it was saying hello.
:'''Yuancai:''' That's when I realized I had to work here someday. I wanted to stay with it.
{{Dialogue End}}
